summary: Official Taiping/Larut Matang and Selama land-office custodianship, the PerakGIS state GIS portal, and the national MyGeoportal UPI service were identified. Direct PerakGIS retrieval timed out and no safe parcel ID plus full polygon geometry, current service configuration, or CRS was obtained; no sample GeoJSON is retained and runtime remains held.
queryOutcomes: Separate English and Malay discovery queries, exact text and actual result URLs are recorded in city-1111-taiping.json.
requestOutcomes: First-party indexed official pages were inspected for PerakGIS, MyGeoportal UPI, and the Taiping District and Land Office. A bounded direct GET to the PerakGIS host timed out after 20 seconds. No anonymous parcel feature request was completed and no unsafe fields were requested.

attemptedRoutes.outcome: Official indexed page identified state GIS applications including Lot Finder; direct TLS-verified fetch timed out after 20 seconds in the research environment.
Official service description readable; UPI is documented as a standardized parcel-location identifier with textual/spatial results, but no Taiping feature geometry was returned.
